Surrounded by an army, and Elisha wasn't worried. 🔥

In 2 Kings 6, the king of Syria sends horses, chariots and a great host to catch one prophet. The servant panics: “Alas, my master! how shall we do?” Elisha prays, and the servant sees the mountain “full of horses and chariots of fire.” Then Elisha feeds his enemies and sends them home. You're never as outnumbered as you look.

Did you know this story? Yes or no 👇
